lines.zh: 我迈开长腿，一步跨过一条沟。
lines.en: I stride wide and step over a ditch.

lines.zh: 我的脖子先过去，身体还在后头。
lines.en: My neck goes first, and the rest of me follows.
I wade slowly into the deep water.
The water only reaches my belly.
I tread the riverbed; the mud is soft.

lines.zh: 我的脚每落一次，地就沉一下。
lines.en: Each footfall makes the ground settle.
I walk the bank, looking for treetops.
I lower my head to check my footing.
The young leaves at the treetops are mine.

lines.zh: 我从林间挤过去，树在摇。
lines.en: I push through the wood, and the trees shake.
I don't walk fast, and never in a hurry.
I wade in; ripples spread.
My tail sweeps the water.

lines.zh: 阳光晒在背脊上，暖得发困。
lines.en: Sun on my spine, warm enough to drowse.
I let my long neck hang down.

lines.zh: 我泡在水里，只露上半身。
lines.en: I soak in the water with only my upper half out.
I stare up at the canopy, thinking nothing.

lines.zh: 我一天要吃掉很多叶子。
lines.en: I eat a great deal of leaves in a day.
The water is cool and pleasant.
I turn my head slowly to look.
The water swirls at my feet.
I give a very long belch.
Heavy footsteps far off.
The sun has shifted a little.
I put my snout into the water.
I'd like to soak here all day.

lines.zh: 树叶在我嘴里嚼得很响。
lines.en: The leaves crunch loudly in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我抬头，够到最高的那枝。
lines.en: I reach up for the highest branch.
You're standing at my feet.

lines.zh: 你要抬头很久才能看到我。
lines.en: You'll have to look up a long while to see me.
I lower my head and come close.

lines.zh: 你的声音从下面传上来。
lines.en: Your voice comes up from below.
I don't intend to step on you.

lines.zh: 你手上的叶子我看见了。
lines.en: I see the leaves in your hand.
There's a great difference in our size.
My snout is very near you.
You needn't run; I move very slowly.

lines.zh: 你在我前脚边，像只甲虫。
lines.en: You stand by my forefoot like a beetle.
My foot is over there — mind it.
I draw my neck back slowly.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，地也跟着沉。
lines.en: I step back, and the ground sinks with me.
I swing my long neck.
I turn my head to look at you.
I can take that.
My hide is thick, and it still hurts.
My long neck pulls back.
I lower my long neck.
I don't quicken my pace.
I crush a stone underfoot.
I shift slowly, like a mountain.
Hold the leaves up and I'll eat.
That's not one mouthful for me.
I lower my head and lean in.
You'll have to hold it higher.
I eat a whole tree a day.
A whole fern clump isn't enough to chew.
Don't let go; hold it higher.
I could eat a basket more.
Bark crunches in my mouth.
Bring more; I'm still hungry.
You bumped into my leg.
Your arrow felt like a mosquito bite.
I lifted my foot and stepped aside.
You got out of the way.
You hit my foreleg and bounced off.
At that touch you sat down hard.

lines.zh: 我的前腿比你的腰还高。
lines.en: My forelegs are taller than your waist.
My steps are too big; there's nothing to be done.
Between us the water splashes everywhere.
Walk farther off next time.
Another stands on the far bank.

lines.zh: 河水漫到我的腹侧，正好。
lines.en: The river reaches my flank — just right.

lines.zh: 它慢慢走过来，水花很大。
lines.en: It wades over, throwing up spray.
Our necks come together.
We walk into the deep water together.
Between us we muddy the water.
This valley is large enough.
The eggs must be laid on the ground to hatch.

lines.zh: 我们在岸边找了一块平地。
lines.en: We find a flat patch on the bank.
Afterward we each go to eat leaves.
I lower my head and take the branch.
My mouth is huge; the thing is tiny.
I swallow the whole branch.

lines.zh: 我站在深水里，脖子最凉。
lines.en: Standing in deep water, my neck cools.
I lift my head with it in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我叼着它抬头，够到高枝。
lines.en: I lift it in my mouth to reach a high branch.
I set it down in front of you.
I can reach it myself.
Two chews and it's gone.
This branch tastes so-so.
Something is moving in the treetops.
The young branches high above smell sweet.
I can reach that tree.
I've fixed on that cluster of young leaves.
Walking over there, the water is shallower.
Your things are in my way.
I'll have to go around.
I begin lowering my head.
I lower my head and strip the canopy.
I'm not far from it now.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，深水漫过膝盖。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg; deep water passes my knees.
That branch right there.
I press it down.
I can reach it now.
I stretch my neck as far as it goes.
The branch snapped at my mouth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把叶子卷进嘴里。
lines.en: I roll the leaves into my mouth slowly.
This tree is nearly bare.

lines.zh: 我半个身子泡在水里降温。
lines.en: Half my body soaks to stay cool.
There's another patch by the water.
I shift forward step by step.
Each step of mine shakes the ground.
No hurry; I can reach it.
This cluster will feed me a while.
I stretch my neck to the treetop.

lines.zh: 侏罗纪的高个子，泡在深水。
lines.en: A Jurassic tall one, wading in deep water.
I lift my head again.
There's nothing left in this tree.
I move further in.
I lift a forefoot and bring it down.
My forefoot comes down.
My neck knocks into you.
I lower my head and butt once.

lines.zh: 这一下很轻，我只用了半分力。
lines.en: That was light; I used a fraction.
I swayed a little too.
You've been pushed into the water.
I missed my footing.
I stop and look at you.
You're still moving — good.
I've lifted my foot again.

lines.zh: 我的脖子先过去，身子还在后头。
lines.en: My neck goes ahead; my body is still behind.
That footfall landed solid.
A deep print is left in the ground.
The morning mist only reaches my chest.
My neck rises above the treetops.
The water here is just right.
First I drink for a long while.
I rise slowly out of the deep water.

lines.zh: 我踩出的第一个脚印很深。
lines.en: My first footprint is deep.
I lift my head just under the clouds.
I walk slowly into the water.
The leaves on the trees are still young.
I smell the river.

lines.zh: 我从林间挤出一个小口。
lines.en: I push a gap open through the trees.
I claim this valley.
The deep water keeps me cool.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住了半个河滩。
lines.en: My shadow covers half the bank.
I swing my tail once, slowly.

lines.zh: 很久没有这样的下午了。
lines.en: It's been a long time since an afternoon like this.
I start looking for something to eat.
When I settle, the ground shakes.

lines.zh: 火烧到我脖子，我抬起头躲。
lines.en: Fire catches my neck and I rear my head away.

lines.zh: 我从河岸滑下去，骨头闷响。
lines.en: I slide off the bank and my bones thud.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的鼻孔进了水。
lines.en: The water is too deep and my nostrils fill.
The blast makes my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 箭扎在我脖子上，像根刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my neck like a thorn.

lines.zh: 那股光让我头晕得厉害。
lines.en: That light leaves me badly dizzy.

lines.zh: 吃了太多叶子也顶不住饿。
lines.en: Even all those leaves can't hold off this hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我退了很远。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and I back away far.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我整头往下栽。
lines.en: The ground vanishes and I plunge down head first.
